Lina R: Quick follow-up on connector policy + SDK surface. Proposal: one canonical ConnectorPolicy (retry, pagination, idempotency, prefetch) and thin adapters per language.

Marco T: +1 on central policy. Go adapter must avoid hidden goroutines/allocations; explicit Cursor.Next(ctx) and no background prefetch by default.

Owen H: TS/Python can give async iterators with .resume(token) and .config(policy). Default pagination.pageSize=100 and maxInFlightPages=1 to keep ordering.

Priya S: Resume tokens should be versioned like v{major}:{opaque}. By default we reject newer-major tokens unless compatibility is opted-in. Emit telemetry events: connector.retry, connector.fallback, connector.resume_match.

Marco T: Also make generateIdempotency default false for Go; let callers provide tokens.

Lina R: Document guarantees: default = at-most-once delivery per item; advanced opt-in for at-least-once (with dedupe hints). PrefetchMode default = sequential.

Owen H: Action items: Lina update RFC with envelope + telemetry, Marco draft Go cursor API and microbench, Priya write resume-token tests, Owen prototype TS iterator fallback example. I'll schedule a 30m sync Wed 11am. :thumbsup:
